headline: Fifteen matches in, the LSC table is still empty, and conference play is 24 days away.
dek: Midwestern State has scored eleven goals and conceded one; Sul Ross State has conceded eight and scored none. Three matches are marked final with no score published, and three more sit past their date with no result recorded.

summary_stat.label: Matches played
summary_stat.detail: Fifteen matches carry a published final score; the season calendar holds 151 in all.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Midwestern State has scored eleven goals in non-conference play, more than any two other programmes have scored together.

chart.caption: Goals scored against opponents from outside the conference, by programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three matches marked final without a published score are Lubbock Christian's — August 15, August 19 and August 22 — and three further matches are past their date with no result recorded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against opponents from outside the conference the eleven programmes have won seven, drawn one and lost five, scoring 26 goals and conceding 24.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian has scored four goals in non-conference play and conceded none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eleven saves for Sul Ross State, more than any other keeper in the collected records.

last_match.line: UT Dallas 3-1 Cal State East Bay, the last of six results collected on August 29.

next_match.line: Saint Edwards away to Cal State Dominguez Hills at 15:00, the only match on the day.

table_state.statement: No conference match has been played, so all eleven programmes sit at 0–0–0 and the table carries early form from non-conference results only.
table_state.footnote: 3–1–0 points · conference play opens September 23, 24 days after this collection · a pre-conference table is a valid state.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
